Placement: `ClassViewer` is a editor-only; put it in *Editor.Build.cs or an editor plugin — never a Game target.
How to use: editor-only; put it in *Editor.Build.cs. After restart, find the panel under Window/Tools or in the relevant asset editor.

Depend: in `YourModule.Build.cs` add `PublicDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[] { "ClassViewer" });`. Use Public when exposing `ClassViewer` types, Private if only calling it; then Generate Project Files and rebuild.

Call: include its `Public/` headers to use exported types; the engine/plugin system loads the module automatically — no manual `LoadModulePtr` needed (use `FModuleManager::LoadModuleChecked` only for lazy loading).
note_cn: `ClassViewer`：它是编辑器侧工具模块（编辑器 UI、面板、细节定制、资产编辑器）；构建规则 `Editor/ClassViewer/ClassViewer.Build.cs`，直接依赖 8 个模块。
note_en: `ClassViewer`: it is an editor-side tool module (editor UI, panels, detail customization, asset editors); build rule `Editor/ClassViewer/ClassViewer.Build.cs`; depends on 8 modules.

cn_steps: `CLI11`：它是对一个第三方库的 UBT 封装，向引擎暴露该库的功能。位于 `ThirdParty`，构建规则 `ThirdParty/CLI11/CLI11.Build.cs`。描述符未声明依赖。
部署：`CLI11` 第三方库封装，优先依赖引擎已包好的上层模块。
怎么用：一般不要直接依赖它；优先用引擎里已封装好该库的上层模块。确需使用时把本模块加进 Build.cs，并包含其第三方头文件。
依赖：在 `YourModule.Build.cs` 加入 `PublicDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[] { "CLI11" });`；对外暴露 `CLI11` 类型用 Public，仅内部调用用 Private，然后 Generate Project Files 并编译。
调用：不要 include 引擎模块头去用它；优先用引擎里封装该库的上层模块，仅必要时包含 ThirdParty 目录下的第三方头文件。
en_steps: `CLI11`: it wraps a third-party library and exposes its functionality to the engine. Located under `ThirdParty`; build rule `ThirdParty/CLI11/CLI11.Build.cs`. The descriptor declares no dependencies.
Placement: `CLI11` is a third-party library wrapper; prefer the engine module that wraps it.
How to use: usually do not depend on it directly; prefer the engine module that already wraps it. If truly needed, add it to Build.cs and include the third-party headers.

Depend: in `YourModule.Build.cs` add `PublicDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[] { "CLI11" });`. Use Public when exposing `CLI11` types, Private if only calling it; then Generate Project Files and rebuild.
Call: do not include engine module headers to use it; use the engine module that wraps this library, and only include its ThirdParty headers when truly needed.
note_cn: `CLI11`：它是对一个第三方库的 UBT 封装，向引擎暴露该库的功能；构建规则 `ThirdParty/CLI11/CLI11.Build.cs`，直接依赖 0 个模块。
note_en: `CLI11`: it wraps a third-party library and exposes its functionality to the engine; build rule `ThirdParty/CLI11/CLI11.Build.cs`; depends on 0 modules.

cn_steps: `ClientBandwidthDebugVisualizer`（Client Bandwidth Debug Visualizer）：它属于网络/在线（复制、Iris、Sockets、HTTP/RPC、Online 子系统、消息总线、MCP）。位于 `Runtime`，构建规则 `Runtime/Online/Experimental/ClientBandwidthDebugVisualizer/ClientBandwidthDebugVisualizer.Build.cs`。直接依赖 5 个模块：`BandwidthDebugDelegates`、`Core`、`CoreUObject`、`Engine`、`EngineSettings`。
部署：`ClientBandwidthDebugVisualizer` 运行时模块，可进游戏包；只在真正调用其 API 的模块里声明依赖。
怎么用：联网代码要在 client 与 server Target 都列出；在线服务在 DefaultEngine.ini 指定实现并配置凭证。

依赖：在 `YourModule.Build.cs` 加入 `PublicDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[] { "ClientBandwidthDebugVisualizer" });`；对外暴露 `ClientBandwidthDebugVisualizer` 类型用 Public，仅内部调用用 Private，然后 Generate Project Files 并编译。
调用：包含其 `Public/` 头文件以使用导出类型；模块由引擎/插件系统自动加载，通常无需手动 `LoadModulePtr`（仅懒加载时才用 `FModuleManager::LoadModuleChecked`）。
